_comment: THE data file an operator (human or AI) edits. Windows are months: 1/3/6/12/36. P = odds (0-100) the pillar is good for crypto by then; 50 = neutral. Quality 0-1. EQUAL-WEIGHT MODEL: every pillar counts the same (1/N of the master) and shares one uniform Impact (config/settings.json 'impact'), so pillars differ ONLY by P and Quality. To add a pillar: give it a name + a quality per window here, plus a P per window in each score_set. No weight, no per-pillar impact. The quant Bitcoin-TA pillar is NEVER edited here - it is computed by the pipeline into data/pillar_scores.json and joins the equal-weight mean automatically.
